class.name: AudioEffectFFTBlock
class.brief_description: Captures audio blocks and updates an FFT texture.
class.description: An audio-bus effect used by the diagnostic spectrum and waveform displays.

method.name: get_fftirow
method.description: Returns the texture row most recently written.

method.name: get_audiosamplerate
method.description: Returns the captured audio sample rate.

method.name: get_audiosamplesize
method.description: Returns the captured frames per block.

method.name: get_opusframesize
method.description: Returns the resampled frames per block.

method.name: push_chunk
method.description: Pushes stereo frames into the analysis buffer.

method.name: set_images
method.description: Sets the image, texture, and FFT analysis window to update.

method.name: set_audiosamplerate
method.description: Sets the captured audio sample rate.

method.name: set_audiosamplesize
method.description: Sets the captured frames per block.

method.name: set_opusframesize
method.description: Sets the resampled frames per block.
